title: Junior Footwear Designer & Product Developer
note: London version of the junior footwear role; asks for 1–2 years or a strong footwear-focused graduate portfolio, on-site five days a week.

facts.summary: Junior footwear designer and developer at the brand's central London office, working with the co-founder and creative director.
facts.duties: Sketch and CAD footwear, build tech packs, research trends, manage sample schedules and fit sessions, keep line sheets and a materials library.
facts.requirements: 1–2 years or a strong graduate footwear portfolio; freehand sketching; Illustrator essential, Rhino a plus; Procreate; footwear construction knowledge.
